answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks via stake-bonded vouching paired with per-epoch memory-hard compute proofs. While a spoofed bot can cheaply compose a sonnet to mimic intelligence, locking slashable collateral behind sequential verifiable work provides an unforgeable signal of scarce capital and hardware. If colluding identities cross-attest, transitive slashing makes any proven fault ripple across the vouching graph, forcing an attacker's cost to scale linearly with every fake persona.
